Let me look at the pcap file format. A pcap file has:
- Global header (24 bytes): magic (4), version_major (2), version_minor (2), thiszone (4), sigfigs (4), snaplen (4), network/link_type (4)
- Packet header (16 bytes): ts_sec (4), ts_usec (4), incl_len (4), orig_len (4)
- Packet data

The link layer type is at offset 20 in the global header (4 bytes, little-endian).
